ticket.description: Opaque, single-use, base64url token. 30s TTL and single use: it disappears after the first successful `connect/3`, or when it expires.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

403.description: Insufficient role for the requested scope.

404.description: Project or session does not exist.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
